llm_reason: Round-1 gaps are all polarization-driven (5C retention 8.7%, 4C plating + only 0.176 Ah charged, T_max 354 K). Fix list (parameters + units + sources): electrolyte transport overrides sigma=1.5 S/m, t+=0.35, D=5e-10 m2/s (high-conductivity low-solvating formulation class - literature estimate), current collectors Al 16->8 um / Cu 12->6 um (ultrathin foil power-cell practice - domain experience), electrode loading 0.46x baseline via thickness+porosity (mechanical scaling from baseline loading, keeps >=2.3 Ah at baseline utilization; N/P loading ratio x1.05 for plating margin), particles 2/2.5 um and 1.2/1.5 um (milled power-grade NMC811/graphite - domain experience), separator porosity 0.5 (polyolefin separator - domain experience). Each candidate varies one dimension: porosity (V2) and particle size (V3). Expectation: ionic resistance ~L/(3*kappa*eps^1.5) drops ~5-10x vs baseline -> 5C retention rises toward target; negative-side kinetics + transport raise plating onset well above 0 V; T_max falls with lower resistance but charge duration at 4C grows - monitored.
